what_this_is: The one candidate-safe projection of MIW question intelligence. Layer 2 (longitudinal family signal) and Layer 3 (present-day answer readiness), in the exact words a candidate sees.
what_this_is_not: Layer 1. The modern repeat tag is computed from the calendar by tools/pastpapers/recurrence_model.py and is neither restated nor overridden here. Nothing in this file can remove a modern tag.
secondary_claim_rule: A longitudinal label reaches a candidate only if it survives on PRINTED_ON_SOURCE_COPY evidence alone. Reach beyond that is reported as WIDER_RECURRENCE_HELD, which asserts that MIW holds more and nothing about when.

readiness_basis.PHASE2_GOVERNED_REVIEW: A Phase-2 record names THIS question as the canonical current answer, carries dated current primary authority and passed independent review.
readiness_basis.TRIAGE_NO_RISK_SIGNAL: Phase-1 triage fired no currentness risk. Nobody has verified the answer against present-day authority.

no_longitudinal_reasons.LONGITUDINAL_FAMILY_NOT_YET_GOVERNED: No canonical family reaches this question. Its modern recurrence tag stands alone. Not a defect and not a licence to invent a family.
no_longitudinal_reasons.NO_CANDIDATE_SAFE_LABEL: The family is governed but every label it earns is internal-only or rests on secondary-claimed dates, and it holds no wider reach to report either.

current_answer_limbs.limb_label: A. The major changes and amendments made by the Manila amendments for the engine department
current_answer_limbs.scope: What the 2010 Manila amendments introduced affecting the engine department, in four groups - new certificates and ranks, new and strengthened competences, fitness for duty, and administration and quality - together with their present standing. Does NOT cover how onboard training is conducted or how competence is assessed.

current_answer_limbs.limb_label: B. Onboard training and the standard of competence under STCW chapter III, the Chief Engineer's role, and the criteria for evaluating competence
current_answer_limbs.scope: What makes onboard training count under chapter III, the four-column structure of the part A competence tables, the specific acts a Chief Engineer must perform, and the criteria for evaluating competence. Does NOT cover what the Manila amendments changed.
Lloyd's Open Form -- the standard-form no cure no pay salvage contract, and the Salvage Convention 1989 / SCOPIC scheme on top of it
General average and particular average -- the two concepts distinguished, the circumstances for a GA declaration, and the average adjuster
The bill of lading -- its three functions, the principal types, and the obligations it creates
Treaty, convention and protocol -- the taxonomy of international instruments and how they relate, as distinct from the adoption process

current_answer_limbs.limb_label: A. Surface crack on a propeller blade found in dry dock
current_answer_limbs.scope: The Chief Engineer's handling of a crack found on a propeller blade: securing the evidence, establishing the extent, reporting to the Company, involving classification and settling the repair, preserving the insurance claim, and root cause. Does NOT extend to the tail-end shaft.

current_answer_limbs.limb_label: B. Surface cracks on the keyway of the tail-end shaft
current_answer_limbs.scope: Cracks at the forward end of the shaft taper and at the keyway: containment and recording, crack detection over the taper and keyway, notification of Company, class and underwriters, the class-approved repair routes and the rule-diameter constraint, root cause, and the consequences of not dealing with the cracks at the proper time. Does NOT extend to the propeller blade.
